clause: Auto-layout alignment + resizing: 9-position + baseline, primary/counter axis, hug/fill/fixed, min/max clamps [STU-DS-041,STU-DS-041a,STU-DS-042,STU-DS-043]

scope.summary: Implement auto-layout alignment and resizing on StudioAutoLayout: a nine-position child-alignment box plus a separate text-baseline alignment toggle; a primary(flow)-axis vs counter-axis distinction where the primary axis governs packing/distribution (incl. the auto/space-between gap) and the counter axis governs cross-alignment, with grid flow resolving alignment per cell; a per-axis resizing mode (hug-contents, fill-container, fixed); and minimum/maximum width/height clamps bounding hug and fill so components neither collapse nor overgrow.
acceptance_criteria: 9-pos+baseline align, primary/counter axis, hug/fill/fixed, min/max clamps solved by LayoutEngine
expected_tests: test: 9-pos + baseline align; primary/counter axis packing vs cross-align; hug/fill/fixed per axis; min/max clamps bound hug+fill

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No alignment/resizing contract; responsive sizing core missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
